arena: classic_generic_2022 procedural_v2 11x9 two-player reply-search-256/8/64 self-play, sample every fourth round

fit_audit.qualification: In-sample selection signal only; this window was used to fit the model and choose the fixed threshold.

fixed_student: Frozen scalar scorer picks its top candidate only when the predicted score margin over static rank zero is at least 0.06; otherwise it keeps rank zero. No weights or threshold were changed after inspecting new maps.
decision: Reject at the predeclared calibration gate: candidate-better independent maps did not exceed static-better maps, and seat one had more harmful than beneficial native-reply replacements. Do not tune the threshold on seed6314000, collect seed6315000 validation, run the untouched seed6300000 complete-game gate, rate, or deploy this student.
interpretation: The high-margin fit advantage did not transfer to independent procedural maps. In-sample confidence was not a reliable tactical safety measure; a representation of the actual opponent response is a more informative next diagnostic than another threshold on this frozen scalar. All scores here are conditional native full-opponent-turn search objectives, not complete-game outcomes or Elo.
